questions.question: Which render mode best suits a logged-in portfolio dashboard that needs no SEO?
questions.explanation: Authenticated, personalised pages gain nothing from SEO and are a good fit for client-only rendering.

questions.question: What does `getPrerenderParams` do on a parameterised server route like `funds/:code`?
options: Returns the list of param values so one HTML file is prerendered per value at build time
questions.explanation: It runs at build time and returns objects like { code } so Angular can prerender each concrete URL.

questions.question: With incremental hydration, what happens to content inside `@defer (hydrate on viewport)`?
options: It is server-rendered as HTML, and its JavaScript is fetched and hydrated when it scrolls into view
It is not rendered on the server at all
It hydrates immediately at startup like the rest of the page
It is removed from the page until the user clicks it
questions.explanation: The server renders full HTML; the client keeps the block dehydrated until the trigger fires, saving JavaScript at startup.

questions.question: Why should browser-only code such as reading `localStorage` go inside `afterNextRender()` in an SSR app?
options: It makes the code run faster on the server
It enables the HTTP transfer cache
afterNextRender only runs in the browser, so server rendering does not crash on missing browser APIs
questions.explanation: Browser globals do not exist on the server; afterNextRender callbacks are skipped during server rendering.
